description: Generic search across entityindex.ai verticals; same data as the vertical-specific tools. Today the only vertical is 'hotels' (country 'andorra'); call list_verticals to see what exists. Parameters: vertical (required), country, area, query, filters (vertical-specific verified booleans; for hotels: spa, pool, parking, pets, ski_in_out, family, plus min_stars and type), limit. Example: {"vertical":"hotels","area":"Soldeu","filters":{"ski_in_out":true}}.
